## Body

Supersedes rule (1) of 'After compacting a seat with a live holding, wake it (F111)'. Since #167 (plan 222) merged 2026-11-08 09:41, the daemon wakes a seat that goes idle after a compaction while holding work: one resume message from pij-bg, plus a parent FYI. First live case: bobcat at 12:21, holding reviewer/173; it resumed on its handover. pm-001 12:21: drop the manual post-compaction wake. Keep (a) the handover handshake before a compact, and (b) the round check: flag to pm-001 any seat that stays idle after its resume, and any seat with a live holding and no own event for over an hour. The wake is one attempt with no retry (herring's #167 note), so a missed one shows up as (b).
